decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Existing ground and First Floor Plans INTGP 1803/EX01, Proposed Ground and First Floor Plans INTGP 1803/PP10, Proposed Elevations INTGP 1803/PP11, Existing and Proposed Block Plans INTGP 1803/PP12 and Site Location Plan, received on 12/09/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the side elevation (western) shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 30 Kingston Avenue TW14 9SL.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension with juliet balcony at rear first floor level and a single storey rear extension
